plan: Drive: from 100 Mile House, about 94 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 97, Timothy Lake Rd, Spout Lake Rd, Mile 108-Horsefly Rd.
Park: 52.2888, -121.41527, pull off on Starlike Lake Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 1.3 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 13 m, about 27 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, season: VERIFY. Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-2, Region 5. Season: no general open season (synopsis page 44, 95%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
